text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Those guys really are strong. I'm still 
freaked out... but.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —I can do even better next time.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~... Didn't Air Shakur just glare at 
Opera O and the others? Scary...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, isn't that amazing against that 
lineup? Feels like something's different 
compared to the Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, right now it's basically the Opera 
O Show, and since she's way too strong, 
it's kinda lacking hype, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still... could Shakur be aiming to run me 
down from behind...? That actually sounds 
kind of fun—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A faint murmur reached her ears. But Air 
Shakur brushed even that aside and—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, I wouldn't have even been able 
to touch 'em. Yet I made it this far in 
*this* Tenno Sho (Spring)."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna overturn all those stacked-up 
impressions, you've got no choice but to 
completely overwhelm 'em.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll crush them completely.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen. Both Doto and Opera 
O will be running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is the Spring Grand 
Prix race. It's the ideal stage to capture 
the crowd's attention and turn their 
expectations upside down.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, everyone would've written me 
off, thinking I don't stand a chance 
against them anymore."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ain't gonna happen. —I'll give 'em a 
performance worth roaring applause for.
